column7: 2026-11-03: Decision for run_pending job errors: run all other due jobs, then re-raise the FIRST exception after they've all run. Reason: user's supervisor restarts the worker and pages someone on crash, so errors must not be swallowed/only logged (rules out catch-and-log). Not built yet; to implement next session. Open question: reschedule the failing job (_schedule_next_run in finally in Job.run) so it doesn't retry every tick - recommended, needs user OK.

2026-11-03: run_pending now implemented (run all due jobs, log each failure, re-raise first after all run); existing tests pass. Still TODO: add a test for it, and get user OK on rescheduling the failing job via finally in Job.run (otherwise it retries every tick). Uncommitted run_all sleep tweak is unrelated.
